description_en: Queries the error logs of a MongoDB instance
name: DescribeErrorLogRecords

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.
If you specify a sharded cluster instance ID for this parameter, you must also specify the NodeId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。
当本参数传入的是分片集群实例ID时，还需要传入NodeId参数
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of a mongos node or shard node in the sharded cluster instance.

This parameter is available only when the DBInstanceId parameter is set to a sharded cluster instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
分片集群实例中Mongos节点ID或Shard节点ID。

当DBInstanceId参数传入的是分片集群实例ID时，本参数才可用
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en:
The role of the node in the instance. Valid values:
primary: primary node.
secondary: secondary node.
search: search node.

If the NodeId parameter is set to a mongos node ID, this parameter can only be set to primary
parameters.help_zh:
实例中节点的角色。取值：
primary：主节点。
secondary：从节点。
search：search节点。

当NodeId参数传入的是Mongos节点ID时，本参数取值只能为primary
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The end time must be later than the start time, and the interval between the end time and the start time cannot exceed one day. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，必须晚于查询开始时间，且与查询开始时间间隔时长不能大于一天。格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 30 to 100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID. For more information about resource groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The keywords to search for. Separate multiple keywords with spaces. You can specify a maximum of 10 keywords
parameters.help_zh: 查询关键字，多个关键字以空格分隔，不超过10个关键字
parameters.name: query_keywords

parameters.help_en: The logical operator for keyword search. Default value: and
parameters.help_zh: 关键字搜索的逻辑操作， 默认值为and
parameters.name: logical_operator

Engine.description_en: The engine type of the current database
Engine.description_zh: 当前数据库的引擎类型

LogRecords.description_en: The list of error log entries

Category.description_en:
The log category. Valid values:
NETWORK: network connectivity log.
ACCESS: access control logs.
-: general log.
COMMAND: slow query log.
SHARDING: cluster log.
STORAGE: DPI engine log.
CONNPOOL: connection pool log.
ASIO: asynchronous I/O log.
WRITE: slow update log
Category.description_zh:
日志类别。返回值：
NETWORK：网络连接日志。
ACCESS：访问控制日志。
-：普通日志。
COMMAND：慢日志。
SHARDING：集群日志。
STORAGE：存储引擎日志。
CONNPOOL：连接池日志。
ASIO：异步IO日志。
WRITE：慢更新日志

ConnInfo.description_en: The connection information of the log

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the log was generated. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is in UTC

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of records per page
